# Widget changelog

## [Unreleased]

## [4.1.0] - 2025-03-01
### Added
- New widget factory

## 4.0.1 - 2025-01-20
### Fixed
- Null deref in factory

## [4.0.0] - 2025-01-01
### ⚠ BREAKING CHANGES
- `createWidget()` renamed to `makeWidget()`
- Removed the legacy `Widget.defaults` export
### Deprecations
- `widget.render()` is deprecated; use `widget.paint()`
**BREAKING**: dropped CommonJS builds

## 3.9.0 - 2024-11-11
### Added
- Widget widgets

## [3.8.0] - 2024-10-01
### Added
- Before the (from, to] range — must not be extracted

## [4.2.0] - 2025-05-05
### Added
- After the range — must not be extracted
